clauses.head: ARTICLE 3. TERM OF AGREEMENT AND RENEWAL 3.1
clauses.name: 3.1 Term
clauses.tail: extended or renewed in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement.
clauses.text: ARTICLE 3. TERM OF AGREEMENT AND RENEWAL 3.1 The Term of this Master Agreement will begin as of the Effective Date and will terminate upon the tenth (10th) anniversary of the Commencement Date, unless earlier terminated, extended or renewed in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement.

clauses.head: 3.2 This Agreement may be renewed by mutual
clauses.name: 3.2 Renewal Terms
clauses.tail: Renewal Terms by an amendment to this Agreement.
clauses.text: 3.2 This Agreement may be renewed by mutual agreement of the parties for two (2) successive Renewal Terms of five (5) years each, subject to the conditions set forth herein and subject to the right of MTC hereunder to terminate this Agreement for cause. The parties may, but are not required to, agree upon options for additional Renewal Terms by an amendment to this Agreement.

clauses.head: 3.3 Should the Parties elect to renew the
clauses.name: 3.3 Renewal Request Timing
clauses.tail: beyond the then-pending termination date.
clauses.text: 3.3 Should the Parties elect to renew the Agreement, they will do so in accordance with the following time requirements, with time being of the essence. At any time within the period from thirty (30) to thirty-two (32) months prior to the expiration of the then current Term of the Agreement, MTC or the Network Operator may make a Renewal Request, by #10069598_v13 13 written Notice to the other in conformity with Section 12.12, to extend the Term for a Renewal Term ending five (5) years beyond the then-pending termination date.

clauses.head: 3.4 Upon receipt by either Party of such
clauses.name: 3.4 Renewal Negotiations
clauses.tail: expiration of the then current Term of the Agreement.
clauses.text: 3.4 Upon receipt by either Party of such a Renewal Request, the Parties shall, within thirty (30) days thereof, enter into good faith negotiations on the terms of the renewal. Either Party may terminate such negotiations by written notice to the other Party at any time after the date that is twenty-eight (28) months prior to the expiration of the then current Term of the Agreement.

clauses.head: 3.5 In the event that the Parties agree
clauses.name: 3.5 Commencement of Renewal Terms
clauses.tail: after the commencement of the last agreed Renewal Term.
clauses.text: 3.5 In the event that the Parties agree to a renewal that results in a five (5) year extension of the Agreement, the first such Renewal Term shall begin on the tenth anniversary date of the Commencement Date. Any subsequent Renewal Term agreed upon in accordance with the process set forth in Section 3.2 shall begin five (5) anniversaries after the commencement of the last agreed Renewal Term.

clauses.head: 3.6 Network Operator Dark Fiber Rights Upon Termination
clauses.name: 3.6.1.1 Quantity
clauses.tail: Network Operator Network Extensions to the MTC Network.
clauses.text: 3.6 Network Operator Dark Fiber Rights Upon Termination or Expiration of the Agreement. 3.6.1 Unless MTC terminates this Agreement for cause, then upon expiration of the Term, subject to (x) obtaining the prior approval of NTIA and any other governmental or regulatory authority having jurisdiction which MTC will use reasonable efforts to obtain and (y) cure, prior to expiration of the Term, of any existing defaults, Network Operator will have the following Network Operator Dark Fiber Rights: 3.6.1.1 Quantity. Subject to all other conditions herein, the Network Operator shall have the right to lease, through an IRU, between four (4) and eight (8) strands of dark fiber of the MTC Network in the Service Area. The maximum number, if greater than four (4), shall not #10069598_v13 14 exceed ten percent (10%) of the total number of strands in any given portion of the MTC Network. The Network Operator's Dark Fiber Rights shall exclude: (a) any dark fiber that may be within the Service Area by virtue of IRUs in favor of MTC; and (b) any portions of the MTC Network that (i) contain as of the Termination Date fewer than 24 strands of otherwise uncommitted fiber and (ii) are not required in order to maintain connection of any then-constructed Network Operator Network Extensions to the MTC Network.

clauses.head: 3.6.1.2 Data for Use in Establishing Exercise Price.
clauses.name: 3.6.1.2 Data for Use in Establishing Exercise Price
clauses.tail: reasonably subject to audit at MTC's discretion.
clauses.text: 3.6.1.2 Data for Use in Establishing Exercise Price. For purposes of determining the price at which Network Operator may exercise the Network Operator Dark Fiber Rights, Network Operator shall demonstrate (a) the amount of funds Network Operator has expended within five (5) years after the Commencement Date to construct one or more Network Operator Network Extensions or MBI Network Extensions that are activated and have begun generating Network Revenue within five (5) years of the Commencement Date and (b) the historical, cumulative, aggregate net operating loss, if any, realized from the performance of its obligations under this Agreement over the period from the Effective Date until the last calendar quarter before the date of the Request for Renewal for which audited financial statements are available, as determined under IFRS. In determining the Network Operator's funds expended for purposes of this Section, any funds traceable to any funding (whether by grant, loan or others) from a governmental body or agency in the United States, including without #10069598_v13 15 limitation federal, state, and local, shall be excluded. The Network Operator shall report to MTC quarterly on the expenditures made and Network Extensions activated during the preceding calendar quarter for which it intends to claim entitlement to discounts provided under this Section. Such report shall include full disclosure as to the source of the funds used for the expenditures and shall be accompanied by an Officer's Certificate certifying that the disclosure is complete and accurate and that the expenditures meet the qualifications of this Section. Network Operator's historical, cumulative, aggregate net operating loss for purposes of this Section must be based on audited results from prior periods of operation of the MTC Network alone. The Network Operator shall maintain and retain, for at least seven (7) years after the Term of this Agreement, documentation substantiating entitlement to any discount in the tables below, and Network Operator shall be reasonably subject to audit at MTC's discretion.

(a) In the event the right to lease dark fiber arises at the end of a Renewal Term, the per strand rate stated in Section 3.6.1.3 or 3.1.6.4, as applicable, (and only such per #10069598_v13 18 strand rate) shall be adjusted by an amount proportionate to the change in CPI from the tenth (10th) anniversary of the Commencement Date to the end of such Renewal Term, with the adjustment calculated using the same methodology as in Section 4.9.4.

clauses.head: (b) The total exercise price shall be based
clauses.name: 3.6.1.5(b) Strand-Based Exercise Price

clauses.text: 3.6.1.6 Time of Payment. The entire applicable price for exercise of the Network Operator's Dark Fiber Rights shall be due and payable in a single lump sum on or before the end of the Term of this Agreement.

clauses.name: 3.6.1.7 Cap on Discounts

clauses.text: 3.6.1.7 Cap on Discounts. Total discounts available under this Section shall not exceed $6,000,000, and the application of any discount shall in no event lower the total exercise price to below $0.

clauses.head: 3.6.1.8 Duration of Lease. A lease of dark
clauses.name: 3.6.1.8 Duration of Lease
clauses.tail: termination or expiration of the Term of this Agreement.
clauses.text: 3.6.1.8 Duration of Lease. A lease of dark fiber pursuant to the exercise of the Network Operator's Dark Fiber Rights shall be for a term of twenty-five (25) years commencing upon termination or expiration of the Term of this Agreement.

clauses.head: 3.6.1.9 Use of Dark Fiber Obtained Through Exercise
clauses.name: 3.6.1.9 Use of Dark Fiber
clauses.tail: applicable fees and charges at then-prevailing prices.
clauses.text: 3.6.1.9 Use of Dark Fiber Obtained Through Exercise of Dark Fiber Rights. Network Operator shall have the right to continue to add extensions to and connect customers to any Network Operator Network Extension completed prior to the inception of a lease of dark fiber pursuant to Section 3.6.1. In the event Network Operator wishes to construct an extension to or connect customers at any point other than on a Network Operator Network Extension completed prior to the inception of a lease of dark fiber pursuant to Section 3.6.1, Network #10069598_v13 19 Operator shall comply with any requirements of MTC's policies then applicable to others, including but not limited to payment of all applicable fees and charges at then-prevailing prices.

clauses.head: 3.6.1.10 Payment During Term of Lease. During the
clauses.name: 3.6.1.10 Payment During Term of Lease
clauses.tail: Network Operator Dark Fiber Strands/Total Sheath Strand combination.
clauses.text: 3.6.1.10 Payment During Term of Lease. During the term of a lease of dark fiber, the Network Operator shall pay MTC (a) any actual, standard charges for inclusion of one or more cards in the then-existing optical chassis and any associated maintenance costs for those cards if not acquired by Network Operator, and (b) a pro rata share of operating costs, based on the percentage of strands, including, without limitation, attachment fees, administrative costs, periodic inspections, maintenance, insurance, and restoration costs for dark fiber leased. The baseline amount of maintenance costs to which this calculation shall apply will be half the actual maintenance costs for monitoring and maintaining the physical plant (but excluding Network equipment and customer premises equipment) for the entire MTC Network during the last two full calendar year prior to the exercise of the Network Operator Dark Fiber Rights. This maintenance amount shall adjust annually based on changes in the CPI as in Section 4.9.4.2. To calculate the pro rata share of such costs for which the Network Operator is liable under this Section, the following formula shall be applied: The sum of (maintenance costs / total fiber miles * Network Operator Dark Fiber Strands/Total Sheath Strands * Actual Network Operator Dark Fiber Strand Mileage) for each #10069598_v13 20 Network Operator Dark Fiber Strands/Total Sheath Strand combination.

clauses.head: 3.6.1.11 Disclaimers of Strands. At the time of
clauses.name: 3.6.1.11 Disclaimers of Strands
clauses.tail: such disclaimed fiber strands and sections shall be void.
clauses.text: 3.6.1.11 Disclaimers of Strands. At the time of exercise of Network Operator Dark Fiber Rights, the Network Operator may disclaim the right to lease or use, through the exercise of Network Operator Dark Fiber Rights, particular strands of leased fiber in particular GIS locations by written notice to MTC. Any such disclaimed mileage shall be excluded in calculating the Network Operator's pro rata shares of maintenance costs and IRU fees. Upon such disclaimer, all Network Operator Dark Fiber Rights with respect to such disclaimed fiber strands and sections shall be void.

clauses.name: 3.6.2 Exceptions to Dark Fiber Rights

clauses.text: 3.6.2 Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Network Operator Dark Fiber Rights shall not arise as described in Section 3.6.1 if (a) MTC terminates the Agreement for cause or (b) Network Operator has notified MTC that it does not wish to renew the Agreement, for no reason or for any reason other than that the last proposal made by MTC to Network Operator during such negotiations will result in Network Operator realizing a net operating loss of any amount over the duration of the proposed Renewal Term as reasonably demonstrated by Network Operator and the Network Operator has invested less than $3,000,000 as determined in accordance with Section 3.6.1.2. In either such event, upon (i) payment to MTC of all amounts owing under this Agreement and (ii) cure of or payment of monetary compensation for any defaults existing at the time of termination or expiration of the Term, as applicable, Network Operator may lease dark fiber in accordance with MTC’s then current Network Policies, or lit services from MTC #10069598_v13 21 at then-current market rates without the benefit of the special pricing or discounts provided in Section 3.6.1.

clauses.head: ARTICLE 4. NETWORK MANAGEMENT, CUSTOMER SERVICE, MAINTENANCE
clauses.name: 4.1 Overview of Network Operator's Responsibilities
clauses.tail: requirements of such agreements, contracts and laws.
clauses.text: ARTICLE 4. NETWORK MANAGEMENT, CUSTOMER SERVICE, MAINTENANCE AND FINANCIAL OBLIGATIONS OF NETWORK OPERATOR 4.1 Overview of Network Operator's Responsibilities. The Network Operator is responsible for all aspects of the management, sales, monitoring, operations, support, and maintenance of the MTC Network. The Network Operator will perform its duties pursuant to this Agreement subject to the reasonable oversight by MTC as set forth herein and MTC's reasonable cooperation with Network Operator in fulfilling the overall objective. In addition to responsibilities set forth in other Sections of this Agreement, Network Operator's responsibilities include, generally: 4.1.1 Managing the physical plant and operations of the MTC Network, including development and publication, subject to MTC's approval, of policies, procedures, systems and controls to ensure the effective operation and optimal use of MTC Network resources, performing all required maintenance and repair, including Dig Safe mark-out on MTC-owned conduit, tree trimming on MTC-owned poles, periodic inspection of facilities, resolving engineering issues, paying all reoccurring maintenance, attachment, and restoration fees of any kind, managing relationships with vendors and service providers, recommending and implementing equipment maintenance strategies and upgrades, tracking customer use of the network for billing and capacity planning purposes; 4.1.2 Maintaining records of all network fiber in the Attachment Database, in accordance with the Fiber Management Plan, which shall include, without limitation, fiber cable route on all Network Extensions, detailed records on splice case configuration, #10069598_v13 22 fiber optic strand continuity and splice map, patch panel configuration, outside plant elements like slack loops, patch panels, cabinets, and splice cases, and attachments; 4.1.3 Maintain, for at least seven (7) years beyond the Term, detailed and accurate records and accounts relating to all payments, transactions and other obligations, responsibilities and rights of the Network Operator under this Agreement; 4.1.4 Make timely payment for all costs for which the Network Operator is responsible under this Agreement; 4.1.5 Monitoring, documenting and reporting on all aspects of the MTC Network including, without limitation, accumulating network performance information to provide information needed to measure performance against KPIs or to detect degradation or network failures of the physical or electronic components; 4.1.6 Maintaining and managing the staff, consultants, agents, and contractors required to support the MTC Network, including human resources functions, development and publication, subject to MTC reasonable approval, of policies and procedures relating thereto, staffing for 24x7 monitoring of the network, and dispatch of field technicians as needed; 4.1.7 All aspects of marketing, sales, contracting, contract management, billing, insurance claims processing, customer support and relations with Wholesale Customers, including, without limitation, leasing of dark fiber (as MTC's agent as specified below), entering into SLAs for lit service, maintenance of websites and development and deployment of customer forms, answering customer inquiries, tracking and resolving customer requests and problems, provisioning services to customers in accordance with their needs and in the timeframes specified in SLAs, performing capacity planning, #10069598_v13 23 detecting and resolving performance degradations, and providing necessary information to MTC and customers; 4.1.8 As MTC’s agent, managing relations with third party facility owners that grant or have granted MTC attachment rights. The Network Operator shall be administratively responsible for ensuring compliance with all of the requirements of such attachment agreements obtained for the MTC Network. These responsibilities shall include, without limitation, timely responding to facility owner and third party requests for make-ready, facility moves and changes, complying with requirements to use and update third party pole life cycle management systems, subscribing to pole owners' pole lifecycle management systems and double pole notification systems and coordinating with other attachers; and 4.1.9 As MTC's agent, managing and ensuring compliance with the Network Policies, attachment agreements and other third party contracts, and applicable federal, state and local law, and taking the initiative to plan and manage, subject to MTC approval, MTC Network stakeholder engagement and communication. The Network Operator shall be administratively responsible for ensuring compliance with all of the requirements of such agreements, contracts and laws.

clauses.name: 4.1.10 Schedule for Initial Submissions

clauses.head: 4.2 Role During Design and Construction of MTC
clauses.name: 4.2.1 Design and Construction Responsibility

clauses.text: 4.2 Role During Design and Construction of MTC Network 4.2.1 Except as expressly stated herein, MTC or its other vendors will be solely responsible for design, engineering, installation and construction decisions and for obtaining pole attachment licenses prior to the Commencement Date. Nonetheless, the Parties acknowledge that it is desirable for the Network Operator to have sufficient opportunity to comment on the design, engineering, installation and construction of the MTC Network to ensure a smooth transition of the operation of the MTC Network to the Network Operator at the Commencement Date and for the MTC Network to meet the expectations of the Parties with respect to its operating capabilities, capacity and characteristics.

clauses.head: 4.2.2 As directed by MTC and consistent with
clauses.name: 4.2.2 Design and Construction Advice
clauses.tail: including without limitation the Network Policies.
clauses.text: 4.2.2 As directed by MTC and consistent with the principles in Section 4.2.1, Network Operator will collaborate with MTC and will provide advice to MTC with respect to: 4.2.2.1 Equipment for installation during construction of the MTC Network, including core network optronics, SONET, Ethernet, and customer premises equipment and advice on maintenance contracts; 4.2.2.2 Fiber optic cable for installation during the construction of the MTC Network, including strand counts and fiber types, and outside plant components, including splice cases and slack loops; 4.2.2.3 Configuration and placement of equipment throughout the network, including configuration of each POI for network equipment, racks, UPS systems, generators, and electrical, and determination as to whether all POIs are required and appropriately situated or whether additional POIs may be needed; 4.2.2.4 Prioritization of Network Segments for implementation based on potential revenue opportunities and customer demands, including helping to identify pilot sections of the MTC Network for early use prior to the Commencement Date; 4.2.2.5 Development of the protocol for acceptance testing of the MTC Network or any Network Segment upon completion of construction thereof; and #10069598_v13 26 4.2.2.6 Development and public posting of policies and practices required by the Grant and the MTC, including without limitation the Network Policies.

clauses.name: 4.2.3 Marketing and Advance Sales

clauses.text: 4.2.3 Network Operator shall initiate marketing and advance sales to potential customers of the MTC Network promptly after the Effective Date and shall report the status and results of such efforts on at least a monthly basis and in such detail as MTC may reasonably request. Such marketing, sales and reporting shall continue throughout the Term.

clauses.head: 4.2.4 With respect to the initial construction of
clauses.name: 4.2.4 Acceptance Testing
clauses.tail: reduced by eighty percent (80%) for resolution of any such challenge.
clauses.text: 4.2.4 With respect to the initial construction of the MTC Network, Network Operator shall have the right to be present during, but shall not be obligated to conduct, any acceptance testing as scheduled by MTC, and to receive copies of any written results or reports of such acceptance testing. When doing so will not adversely impact the construction schedule, MTC shall provide Network Operator with seven (7) days notice in accordance with Section 12.12 prior to any acceptance testing. Whether or not Network Operator is present during any testing following such notice, each Party shall be deemed to have accepted the results of any acceptance test unless it delivers to the other Party a written challenge thereto no later than five (5) business days after receipt of such results (which may be transmitted electronically), which challenge must be certified as made in good faith and may be based only on alleged noncompliance with the agreed acceptance testing protocol. Any such acceptance of results shall be without prejudice to any rights MTC may have vis-à-vis the Design-Build Contractor. Any challenge made timely and in accordance with this Section shall be resolved as expeditiously as possible in accordance with the dispute resolution procedures of ARTICLE 11, except that the #10069598_v13 27 time periods stated in said Article shall be reduced by eighty percent (80%) for resolution of any such challenge.

clauses.head: 4.2.5 In the event MTC requests Network Operator
clauses.name: 4.2.5 Additional Services
clauses.tail: commercially reasonable terms for such additional services.
clauses.text: 4.2.5 In the event MTC requests Network Operator to perform any services with respect to the design, engineering, installation or construction of the MTC Network beyond the role of the Network Operator as defined herein, the Network Operator shall promptly so notify MTC and, to the extent MTC requires the Network Operator to provide such additional services the Network Operator shall do so and the Parties shall negotiate an amendment hereto that affords commercially reasonable terms for such additional services.

clauses.head: 4.2.6 Beginning on the Effective Date and continuing
clauses.name: 4.2.6 Grant and Funding Assistance

clauses.text: 4.2.6 Beginning on the Effective Date and continuing through the Term of the Agreement, the Network Operator shall assist MTC in the preparation of all information, material, documentation, and reports that may be reasonably required or requested by MTC, including without limitation, documentation on network performance, documentation related to requests for reimbursement, periodic reports required in connection with the Grant and other funding sources for the MTC Network, and audit materials.

clauses.head: 4.3 Transition of Control 4.3.1 Ramp-up Plan. Within
clauses.name: 4.3.1 Ramp-up Plan
clauses.tail: reductions they should receive as legacy circuits are decommissioned.
clauses.text: 4.3 Transition of Control 4.3.1 Ramp-up Plan. Within thirty (30) days of the Effective Date, Network Operator shall begin working with ITD and EOPSS to prepare and submit to MTC within nine (9) months, for approval by MTC, EOPSS and ITD, a detailed Ramp-Up Plan for migration of ITD and EOPSS sites to the MTC Network. Such detailed Ramp-Up Plan shall include but need not be limited to: #10069598_v13 28 4.3.1.1 A communication plan to encourage immediate adoption of service by CAIs and, through ITD or EOPSS, by Massachusetts state agencies; 4.3.1.2 Advise agencies on their proposed specific technical approach to be used in re-hosting ITD and EOPSS current services onto the MTC Network; 4.3.1.3 The planned network configuration and specific services to be used in support of ITD and EOPSS including technical measures required to ensure separation of MassDOT, ITD and EOPSS traffic and service level guarantees; 4.3.1.4 A clear delineation of responsibilities and demarcation between the MTC Network, and the state facilities; 4.3.1.5 A description of the customer support and migration support that the Network Operator will provide to ITD and EOPSS, and what those agencies will be specifically responsible for; 4.3.1.6 A timetable for system turn-on based on the supplied construction rollout plan, for migration from legacy to new circuits, and for decommissioning of legacy circuits; and 4.3.1.7 Recommendations for ITD and EOPSS to implement to ensure that they obtain the bill reductions they should receive as legacy circuits are decommissioned.

clauses.head: The Parties intend that Network Operator be responsible
clauses.name: 4.3.1 Migration Responsibilities
clauses.tail: possible terms thereof to implement the intent of this Section.
clauses.text: The Parties intend that Network Operator be responsible for preparing the MTC Network for migration of ITD and EOPSS to the MTC Network but that ITD and EOPSS will be responsible for all activities outside the demarcation point(s) that are required for such migration. MTC will #10069598_v13 29 provide reasonable accommodation to permit ITD and/or EOPSS to engage Network Operator separately to provide services beyond the scope contemplated herein. In the event MTC has not executed its agreements with ITD and/or EOPSS before the Effective Date, Network Operator will provide comments and advice to MTC regarding possible terms thereof to implement the intent of this Section.

clauses.name: 4.3.2 Network Segment Transition
clauses.tail: segments are completed and handed over to the Network Operator.
clauses.text: 4.3.2 Unless the Parties otherwise agree, Network Operator's responsibilities with respect to a given Network Segment will commence immediately upon acceptance by MTC and Network Operator of the results of acceptance testing for that Segment as passing or, in the event of a challenge, resolution of such challenge. MTC and Network Operator shall collaborate in an effort to achieve a cost-effective rollout and transition of network segments, in order to maximize Network Revenue as early as practicable as network segments are completed and handed over to the Network Operator.

clauses.head: 4.3.3 Network Operator shall administer on behalf of
clauses.name: 4.3.3 Design-Build Warranty Administration

clauses.text: 4.3.3 Network Operator shall administer on behalf of MTC those provisions of MTC's agreement with the Design-Build Contractor relating to warranty repair of the MTC Network the Design-Build Contractor constructs. Network Operator shall not incur legal fees and expenses in the event of disputes with the Design-Build Contractor regarding its warranty responsibilities without MTC's prior approval and shall not be required to incur such legal fees and expenses except to the extent MTC agrees to pay reimbursement. MTC shall provide reasonable cooperation to enable Network Operator in such administration. For avoidance of doubt, Network Operator shall have no financial liability for payment of any part of the Contract Price earned by Design-Build Contractor under its Agreement with MTC..

clauses.name: 4.3.4 Attachment Database

clauses.text: 4.3.4 Beginning on the Commencement Date, Network Operator shall take over from MTC the maintenance, but not ownership, of the Attachment Database as defined in the Agreement for Owner's Project Management Services between MTC and its Owner's Project Manager. Network Operator shall keep the Attachment Database current and shall update the Database to reflect any Network Extension and costs associated therewith. Network Operator and MTC shall confer regarding the data to be included in or added to the Attachment Database after Network Operator assumes this responsibility. Network Operator shall turn over the Attachment Database to MTC upon termination or expiration of the Agreement. Network Operator acknowledges that MTC owns and shall own any intellectual property, software, licenses and derivative works of or associated with use of the Attachment Database. Any assignment or sublicense of software that MTC grants to the Network Operator at any time during the term of this Agreement shall be limited in time and shall expire upon termination or expiration of the Agreement, with all rights reverting to MTC upon expiration.

clauses.name: 4.5.1 Coordination

clauses.text: 4.5 Network Extensions and Development 4.5.1 Network Operator and MTC will mutually and regularly consult with each other to coordinate construction of Network Extensions, Interconnections and other facilities for Wholesale and Retail Services.

clauses.name: 4.5.2 Establishment of Fiber Management Plan

clauses.text: 4.5.2 Establishment of Fiber Management Plan. Within six (6) months after execution of this Agreement, Network Operator shall prepare and submit to MTC for approval a complete draft of the Fiber Management Plan. The draft of such plan approved by MTC shall be the Fiber Management Plan. The Fiber Management Plan must contain the following required elements: 4.5.2.1 A plan for allocation of use of strands of fiber among the Network Operator, ITD and EOPSS, and users to be determined later by MTC, consistent with the Strand Allocation Plan attached as Exhibit B; 4.5.2.2 Detailed procedures and criteria for permitting Interconnections to the MTC Network; 4.5.2.3 Management practices to be used in controlling and tracking the use of the MTC Network fiber; 4.5.2.4 A definition of the point of demarcation between the MTC Network and any Network Extension; and 4.5.2.5 Technical requirements to be met by persons connecting to the MTC Network.

clauses.head: 4.5.3 MTC will not approve the Fiber Management
clauses.name: 4.5.3 Approval Criteria
clauses.tail: 4.5.3.3 Is consistent with Network Policies.
clauses.text: 4.5.3 MTC will not approve the Fiber Management Plan unless it: 4.5.3.1 Is reasonably calculated to optimize use of the MTC Network in a manner consistent with MBI's legislatively stated mission, and requirements and restrictions of the Grant, including, without limitation, the Notice of Funds Availability and any Special Award Conditions contained therein; #10069598_v13 32 4.5.3.2 Is based on the technical feasibility of Interconnection requests, does not create the potential for excessive stranded segments of fiber, addresses the existing and anticipated capacity requirements of the MTC Network; and 4.5.3.3 Is consistent with Network Policies.

clauses.name: 4.5.4 No Ownership or IRU
clauses.tail: Network Operator and signatory to this Agreement.

clauses.name: 4.5.5 Network Operator Network Extensions

clauses.text: 4.5.5 Network Operator Network Extensions. Network Operator shall have a non-exclusive right to undertake the construction and provisioning of Network Extensions at its own expense to expand beyond the MTC Network in accordance with the Network Policies. Any Network Operator Network Extensions of the MTC Network made pursuant to this Section shall be the sole property of the Network Operator, unless MTC and Network Operator agree otherwise prior to the construction of such an extension.

clauses.text: 4.5.6 Wholesale Customer Extensions. Subject to the Network Policies and Section 4.7, below, Wholesale Customers may Interconnect to the MTC Network and will be permitted to invest their own funds to create Network Extensions.

clauses.text: 4.5.6.1 The Network Operator will engage one or more qualified contractors to complete the Interconnection in accordance with the Fiber Management Plan.

clauses.name: 4.5.6.2 Price Schedule Terms
clauses.text: 4.5.6.2 The Network Operator shall include in the Price Schedule all charges, requirements and procedures applicable to a Wholesale Customer Extension.

clauses.text: 4.5.6.3 Network Extensions funded by and constructed for any Wholesale Customer pursuant to this Section shall be the sole property of such Wholesale Customer or its designee.

clauses.head: 4.5.7 MBI Network Extensions. Following consultation and coordination
clauses.name: 4.5.7 MBI Network Extensions
clauses.tail: Network Operator shall maintain and operate it as such.
clauses.text: 4.5.7 MBI Network Extensions. Following consultation and coordination with the Network Operator, MTC may elect to develop MBI Network Extensions. The construction and operation of any MBI Network Extensions may be performed by an entity selected by MTC independent of this Agreement. Network Operator shall have the same role and rights relative to the MBI Network Extensions as are set forth in section 4.2 of this Agreement or as otherwise agreed between MTC and Network Operator, and any such MBI Network Extension shall be designed, constructed and operated in a manner consistent with, and that will not adversely affect achievement by Network Operator of, the obligations under any SLA with respect to the MTC Network. MTC shall own any MBI Network Extension, regardless of the source of its funding, which shall become part of the MTC Network and Network Operator shall maintain and operate it as such.

clauses.head: 4.6 System Upgrades and Updates 4.6.1 Network Operator
clauses.name: 4.6.1 System Upgrades and Updates
clauses.tail: available amount in the CAPEX Upgrade and Update Fund.
clauses.text: 4.6 System Upgrades and Updates 4.6.1 Network Operator is required to periodically update or upgrade the electronics and other components on the MTC Network during the Term of this Agreement in order to maintain the carrier-grade quality and reliability of services offered thereon. Upgrades to the capacity and performance of the MTC Network are to #10069598_v13 34 be made in order to support customer needs or provide new and enhanced services over the MTC Network. Updates and upgrades of the fiber and other components of the MTC Network will be funded through the CAPEX Upgrade and Update Fund as provided in Section 4.9.6, below. Network Operator may undertake such expenditures as may be available in the CAPEX Upgrade and Update Fund for upgrading and updating the MTC Network subject to the then-current Annual Plan approved by MTC. Additionally, MTC may reasonably direct Network Operator to undertake capital expenditures required to upgrade or update the MTC Network, provided that these expenditures will not exceed the currently available amount in the CAPEX Upgrade and Update Fund.

clauses.head: 4.6.2 Nothing in this Section precludes MTC or
clauses.name: 4.6.2 Additional Resources
clauses.tail: upgrades or updates to the MTC Network.
clauses.text: 4.6.2 Nothing in this Section precludes MTC or the Network Operator from using its own resources, in excess of the CAPEX Upgrade and Update Fund, to make upgrades or updates to the MTC Network.

clauses.head: 4.7 Wholesale Service 4.7.1 Network Operator is solely
clauses.name: 4.7.1 Wholesale Service Responsibility
clauses.tail: dispute resolution provisions of ARTICLE 11.
clauses.text: 4.7 Wholesale Service 4.7.1 Network Operator is solely and fully responsible for the marketing, provisioning and support of such Wholesale Service to Wholesale Customers as may be required by these providers to, in turn, deliver services to end users. Any and all functions, responsibilities, activities and tasks, whether or not specifically described in this Agreement or in Wholesale Customer contracts, which are required for the proper performance and provision of the Services are an inherent part of, or a necessary sub-part included within, the Services. If such functions, responsibilities, activities and tasks are determined to be required for the proper performance and provision of the Services or are an inherent part, or a necessary sub-part included within, the Services, such functions, responsibilities, activities and tasks shall be deemed to be implied by and included within #10069598_v13 35 the scope of the Services, to the same extent and in the same manner as if specifically described in the Agreement (and, as applicable, Wholesale Customer contracts). Each such determination shall be made by agreement of the Parties or resolved pursuant to the dispute resolution provisions of ARTICLE 11.

clauses.head: 4.7.2 Network Operator shall provide Wholesale Service as
clauses.name: 4.7.2 Wholesale Rates
clauses.tail: applicable rates in the then-current Price Schedule.
clauses.text: 4.7.2 Network Operator shall provide Wholesale Service as required by MassDOT, EOPSS, ITD, and Third Party Providers at rates that are equal to or less than the Price Caps in Exhibit F, except that charges for Wholesale Services to MassDOT, EOPSS and ITD shall not exceed 85% of the applicable rates in the then-current Price Schedule.

clauses.head: 4.7.3 Each Third Party Service Provider utilizing the
clauses.name: 4.7.3 Wholesale Customer Contracts
clauses.tail: will contain provisions acknowledging the foregoing assignment.
clauses.text: 4.7.3 Each Third Party Service Provider utilizing the MTC Network and each other entity whose facilities will Interconnect with the MTC Network must execute a contract with Network Operator in a form to be approved by MTC prior to the start of any Wholesale Service. The Network Operator may not materially amend or modify the approved form of contract without prior written approval of MTC, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld. The Network Operator hereby assigns to MTC or its designee each contract with a Third Party Service Provider, other than a Third Party Service Provider whose connection is made directly on a Network Operator Network Extension, which assignment shall be effective upon termination of this Agreement. Each Third Party Service Provider contract to which the foregoing assignment applies will contain provisions acknowledging the foregoing assignment.

clauses.head: 4.7.4 Marketing of Dark Fiber Leases to Dark
clauses.name: 4.7.4 Marketing of Dark Fiber Leases
clauses.tail: Network Operator itself, by means of an IRU.
clauses.text: 4.7.4 Marketing of Dark Fiber Leases to Dark Fiber Customers. Network Operator will serve as MTC's agent to lease dark fiber on the MTC Network to any Dark #10069598_v13 36 Fiber Customer (which may also be a Third Party Service Provider) so requesting, other than Network Operator itself, by means of an IRU.

clauses.head: 4.7.4.1 Any such lease shall be (a) consistent
clauses.name: 4.7.4.1 Dark Fiber Lease Terms
clauses.tail: from time to time in accordance with this Agreement.
clauses.text: 4.7.4.1 Any such lease shall be (a) consistent with the then-approved Fiber Management Plan and subject to all Network Policies except to the extent exempted therefrom by MTC, (b) on standard lease terms and conditions approved in advance by MTC, and (c) at a the price of $60/mile/strand/month which constitutes the Dark Fiber Mile fee pursuant to the Pricing Schedule, as the same may be adjusted from time to time in accordance with this Agreement.

clauses.head: 4.7.4.2 Upon receipt of a request from a Dark Fiber Customer to lease Dark Fiber in accordance with Section 4.7.4.1, Network Operator shall present the request to MTC for approval of the lease.
clauses.name: 4.7.4.2 Compliant Lease Requests
clauses.text: 4.7.4.2 Upon receipt of a request from a Dark Fiber Customer to lease Dark Fiber in accordance with Section 4.7.4.1, Network Operator shall present the request to MTC for approval of the lease.

clauses.head: 4.7.4.3 Upon receipt of a request from a
clauses.name: 4.7.4.3 Nonstandard Lease Requests
clauses.tail: networks directly interconnected to the MTC Network.
clauses.text: 4.7.4.3 Upon receipt of a request from a Dark Fiber Customer to lease Dark Fiber that does not comply with the terms set forth in Section 4.7.4.1 (i.e., one proposing deviations from standard terms, conditions and pricing), the Network Operator shall present such request to MTC together with a written explanation of each deviation, the reasons therefor and anticipated benefits and detriments thereof. Any such request must be approved by Network Operator and MTC. The Parties will develop guidelines for their mutual decision-making regarding such non-standard lease terms, with the expectation that leases to U.S. Federal government customers requesting leases of dark fiber for use in connection with national security will be accommodated, and that #10069598_v13 37 favorable consideration will be given to leases of point to point dark fiber circuits between discrete points on the MTC Network or on networks directly interconnected to the MTC Network.

clauses.head: 4.7.4.4 Where the Dark Fiber Customer requests a
clauses.name: 4.7.4.4 Network Operator Extension Lease
clauses.tail: such lease and its terms to MTC upon request.
clauses.text: 4.7.4.4 Where the Dark Fiber Customer requests a lease of dark fiber on a Network Operator Network Extension contiguous with the dark fiber on the MTC Network and the Network Operator and Dark Fiber Customer agree to the terms of an agreement for such lease, the Network Operator shall execute a separate agreement, IRU or instrument in writing for such lease, in its own name. The Network Operator shall disclose any such lease and its terms to MTC upon request.

clauses.head: 4.7.4.5 All payments received by the Network Operator
clauses.name: 4.7.4.5 Dark Fiber Payments
clauses.tail: Network Operator shall constitute Network Revenue.
clauses.text: 4.7.4.5 All payments received by the Network Operator on account of an IRU to a Dark Fiber Customer during the Term of this Agreement on account of a lease of dark fiber on the MTC Network shall be payable 50% to Network Operator and 50% to MTC. For avoidance of doubt, this does not include revenue from the lease of Dark Fiber on a Network Operator Network Extension. The 50% portion payable to Network Operator shall constitute Network Revenue.

clauses.head: 4.7.5 Wholesale Pricing. The Network Operator shall establish
clauses.name: 4.7.5 Wholesale Pricing
clauses.tail: Exhibit F, as amended from time to time pursuant to ARTICLE 6.
clauses.text: 4.7.5 Wholesale Pricing. The Network Operator shall establish and publish a Price Schedule setting forth charges for each and every Wholesale Service offered. Network Operator’s Price Schedule shall be subject to approval by MTC and shall be consistent with the Price Caps as set forth in Exhibit F, as amended from time to time pursuant to ARTICLE 6.

clauses.head: 4.7.5.1 The Network Operator shall make the Price
clauses.name: 4.7.5.1 Publication of Price Schedule
clauses.tail: contemporaneous access to the pricing contained therein.
clauses.text: 4.7.5.1 The Network Operator shall make the Price Schedule publicly available on the Network Operator's website to ensure that all Wholesale Customers have equal and contemporaneous access to the pricing contained therein.

clauses.head: 4.7.5.2 To the extent requested by the Network
clauses.name: 4.7.5.2 Annual Price Updates
clauses.tail: unless and until MTC has approved it.
clauses.text: 4.7.5.2 To the extent requested by the Network Operator, the Price Schedules, including the Price Caps, shall be updated on an annual basis on each anniversary of the Effective Date of the Agreement subject to approval by MTC. No increase in pricing by an amount in excess of an increase in the CPI (calculated by the same methodology as described in Section 4.9.4.2 below) shall be applied or publicized unless and until MTC has approved it.

clauses.head: 4.7.5.3 MTC shall have the right, but not the obligation, to post the Price Schedule on its own website.
clauses.name: 4.7.5.3 MTC Posting Right
clauses.text: 4.7.5.3 MTC shall have the right, but not the obligation, to post the Price Schedule on its own website.

clauses.head: 4.8 Retail Service by Network Operator Affiliates. Network
clauses.name: 4.8 Retail Service by Network Operator Affiliates
clauses.tail: Network Operator that is a Third Party Service Provider.
clauses.text: 4.8 Retail Service by Network Operator Affiliates. Network Operator shall not provide Retail Services. This prohibition shall not preclude a subsidiary or other Affiliate of the Network Operator from being a Third Party Service Provider, provided that any such subsidiary or Affiliate shall enter into a contract with the Network Operator on a non- discriminatory basis, on terms and conditions no more favorable than those offered to other Third Party Service Providers. In order to enforce this provision, MTC shall have the right to audit the Retail Service activities of any subsidiary or other Affiliate of the Network Operator that is a Third Party Service Provider.

clauses.head: 4.9 Financial Responsibilities and Rights of the Network
clauses.name: 4.9.1 Costs and Expenses
clauses.tail: agreements with or otherwise imposed by third parties.
clauses.text: 4.9 Financial Responsibilities and Rights of the Network Operator 4.9.1 Costs and Expenses. Beginning on the Effective Date, Network Operator will pay for all ongoing costs of operating the MTC Network and the Network Operator Network Extensions and all costs of compliance with the terms of this Agreement, including, but not limited to, salaries and benefits of the employees of Network Operator, contractor fees, rent, travel, equipment purchases, leases and maintenance contracts, expenses of marketing and sales, customer service, billing and collection, 24/7 network monitoring, maintenance, repairs, recurring pole attachment fees, recurring conduit fees, recurring IRU or right-of-way fees, software license and maintenance and support fees, premiums for surety bonds that may be required by pole owners or conduit owners, Network Operator’s taxes, taxes imposed by municipalities on property of the MTC Network, regulatory fees applicable to operation of the MTC Network, Network Operator’s insurance costs and all other operating and monitoring expenses contemplated by this Agreement, unless expressly excepted from any such requirement by MTC in writing. Other than its own expenses in offering MTC advice in accordance with this Agreement, Network Operator is not responsible for the funding of the design, engineering, installation or construction of the MTC Network, for any up-front capital costs associated with obtaining IRUs for backhaul fiber routes between Springfield, MA and Boston, MA or Ayer, MA and Boston, MA or elsewhere, or any costs associated with the design, engineering, installation, or construction of any MBI Network Extensions, except to the extent that the Network Operator proposes to and is selected by MTC to construct any such extension. MTC and Network Operator shall work cooperatively in #10069598_v13 40 their respective capacities under this Agreement to minimize the costs that may be incurred under agreements with or otherwise imposed by third parties.

clauses.head: 4.9.2 Provisions Regarding Agreements Between MTC and Others.
clauses.name: 4.9.2.1 Informational Agreements
clauses.tail: listed in Exhibit I hereto, for informational purposes only.
clauses.text: 4.9.2 Provisions Regarding Agreements Between MTC and Others. 4.9.2.1 The Network Operator acknowledges that, prior to the Effective Date, it has been provided with copies of the executed or draft agreements listed in Exhibit I hereto, for informational purposes only.

clauses.head: 4.9.2.2 The Network Operator acknowledges that, prior to
clauses.name: 4.9.2.2 Administered Agreements
clauses.tail: will have the responsibilities described in this Agreement.
clauses.text: 4.9.2.2 The Network Operator acknowledges that, prior to the Effective Date, it has been provided with copies of the executed or draft agreements listed in Exhibit J hereto, with respect to which, when executed, Network Operator will have the responsibilities described in this Agreement.

clauses.head: 4.9.2.3 The Parties acknowledge that, after the Effective
clauses.name: 4.9.2.3 Future Third-Party Agreements
clauses.tail: will have the responsibilities described in this Agreement.
clauses.text: 4.9.2.3 The Parties acknowledge that, after the Effective Date, MTC will be required to enter into agreements with third parties other than those listed in Exhibit J in order to complete construction of the MTC Network, to construct MBI Network Extensions, and for other purposes aimed at maintaining or enhancing the extent, structure, functioning and viability of the MTC Network, including but not limited to agreements to use or obtain access to the property of third parties, with respect to which, when executed, Network Operator will have the responsibilities described in this Agreement.

clauses.head: 4.9.2.4 In the course of negotiating the terms
clauses.name: 4.9.2.4 Consultation on Agreements
clauses.tail: alternative contractual term recommended by Network Operator.
clauses.text: 4.9.2.4 In the course of negotiating the terms of any unexecuted agreements listed in Exhibit J or of the type described in Section 4.9.2.3, or agreements with other third persons the terms of which MTC wishes #10069598_v13 41 the Network Operator is to administer or with which Network Operator is to comply, MTC shall confer with Network Operator concerning the proposed terms thereof and Network Operator shall advise MTC concerning such proposed terms and alternatives thereto, shall identify in writing any proposed terms it believes materially differ from (i) those previously disclosed or (ii) those which are commercially reasonable or prevalent in the industry, and, as a precondition to exercising the right to object set forth in Section 4.9.2.5, shall provide in writing a good faith estimate of the incremental cost to Network Operator of administering or complying with the proposed contractual term as compared with the most expensive alternative contractual term recommended by Network Operator.

clauses.head: 4.9.2.5 In the event that, in the course
clauses.name: 4.9.2.5 Incremental Cost Credit
clauses.tail: all principal amounts have been credited.
clauses.text: 4.9.2.5 In the event that, in the course of negotiating the terms of any unexecuted agreements of the types described in Section 4.9.2.4, MTC executes an agreement containing contractual terms as to which Network Operator provided, during the course of the negotiations, a good faith estimate of incremental cost in accordance with Section 4.9.2.4, Network Operator shall be entitled take a credit against the amount of revenue sharing payments due and payable under Section 4.9.5 after the execution of such agreement for the amount of incremental cost Network Operator demonstrates it has actually incurred and paid as a result of MTC's agreeing to the contractual #10069598_v13 42 term objected to. Network Operator shall take commercially reasonable efforts to avoid or mitigate such costs. If Network Operator incurs and pays such incremental costs during a year in which no revenue sharing payment is due and payable, (a) Network Operator may carry such credit forward to one or more years in which a revenue sharing payment is next due and payable or, if none or if the amount of the revenue sharing payment is insufficient to cover such costs, may apply such credit against the price of any dark fiber it leases from MTC upon termination of this Agreement, and (b) the amount of the credit so carried forward shall accrue simple interest at the rate referenced in Section 12.4, which interest shall be taken as a further credit after all principal amounts have been credited.

clauses.head: 4.9.2.6 In the event of a dispute concerning
clauses.name: 4.9.2.6 Credit Disputes
clauses.tail: Dispute Resolution provisions of ARTICLE 11.
clauses.text: 4.9.2.6 In the event of a dispute concerning the applicability of this Subsection and/or the amount of any credit claimed or offered hereunder, the parties shall resort to the Dispute Resolution provisions of ARTICLE 11.

clauses.head: 4.9.2.7 With respect to the agreements listed in
clauses.name: 4.9.2.7 Agency Role
clauses.tail: role and agency relationship with MTC for that purpose.
clauses.text: 4.9.2.7 With respect to the agreements listed in Exhibit J or of the type described in Section 4.9.2.3, the Network Operator shall act as agent of MTC in its interaction and communications with any such third parties, as appropriate or as required in order to fulfill Network Operator’s obligations under this Agreement. Network Operator shall not have, and shall take no action implying that it has, authority to terminate or materially modify any provision of such an agreement or #10069598_v13 43 to waive any material rights of MTC thereunder. MTC shall take reasonable steps to notify any such third parties of Network Operator’s role and agency relationship with MTC for that purpose.

clauses.head: 4.9.2.8 In the event the conditions described in
clauses.name: 4.9.2.8 Commencement Delay Reduction
clauses.tail: dispute resolution provisions of ARTICLE 11.
clauses.text: 4.9.2.8 In the event the conditions described in clause (a) of the definition of the term "Commencement Date" have not occurred earlier than thirty (30) months after the Effective Date, on account of delay in implementing any third party contracts or a delay due or attributable to MTC or a delay in performance by any such third parties, the amount of any payments coming due under Sections 4.9.4 and 4.9.6 between the end of the thirtieth month after the Effective Date and the date the conditions in such clause (a) have occurred shall be reduced in proportion to the average shortfall (from 90%) in the percentage of CAIs that have been connected as of the end of each week during that period. Any dispute as to the amount of any such reduction shall be resolved in accordance with the dispute resolution provisions of ARTICLE 11.

clauses.head: 4.9.2.9 MTC agrees that the standards for design,
clauses.name: 4.9.2.9 Design and Construction Standards
clauses.tail: hereafter in performing Network Operator’s obligations.
clauses.text: 4.9.2.9 MTC agrees that the standards for design, construction and equipment for the MTC Network are critical to (a) achieving the SLAs identified in this Agreement, and (b) meeting the schedule and financial expectations of the Parties. MTC represents and agrees that it will seek advice from Network Operator regarding design decisions and take commercially reasonable steps to have the MTC Network designed and built so as to facilitate Network Operator’s achievement #10069598_v13 44 of the parameters established by this Agreement or agreed upon hereafter in performing Network Operator’s obligations.

clauses.head: 4.9.3 Annual Plan Reporting 4.9.3.1 Within sixty (60)
clauses.name: 4.9.3.1 Initial Plan
clauses.tail: Network Operator for the period covered by the initial plan.
clauses.text: 4.9.3 Annual Plan Reporting 4.9.3.1 Within sixty (60) days of the Effective Date, the Network Operator shall prepare and submit to MTC an initial plan for the period from the Effective Date through the end of the calendar year in which the Effective Date occurs. The initial plan shall include a narrative outlining the principal activities and anticipated expenditures of the Network Operator for the period covered by the initial plan.

clauses.head: 4.9.3.2 Beginning with the first business day of
clauses.name: 4.9.3.2 Annual Plan
clauses.tail: approval by MTC, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
clauses.text: 4.9.3.2 Beginning with the first business day of the fourth quarter of the calendar year covered by the initial plan required hereunder, and by the beginning of each fourth calendar quarter thereafter during the Term of this Agreement, the Network Operator shall prepare and submit to MTC an Annual Plan. The Annual Plan shall include an annual plan for the succeeding calendar year and a three (3) year plan. Each plan shall specify, among other things, expected Network Revenue, all expected operating costs associated with the MTC Network, and all CAPEX Upgrades and Updates planned to be undertaken within the respective one- and three-year periods, as well as such other information and detail as may be requested by the IPT. The Network Operator will develop the priorities and schedule for CAPEX Upgrades and Updates in coordination and consultation with #10069598_v13 45 the IPT. The Annual Plan shall be subject to approval by MTC, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

clauses.head: 4.9.4 Annual Oversight Fee. Network Operator shall pay
clauses.name: 4.9.4 Annual Oversight Fee
clauses.tail: below for additional detail).
clauses.text: 4.9.4 Annual Oversight Fee. Network Operator shall pay an Annual Oversight Fee to MTC. This fee shall be paid annually in four (4) equal parts at the beginning of each calendar quarter, commencing with the Effective Date, at the following rates: •Year 1 - $160,000/yr ($40,000/qtr) •Year 2 - $280,000/yr ($70,000/qtr) •Year 3 - $325,000/yr ($81,250/qtr) •Year 4 - $490,000/yr ($122,500/qtr) •Year 5 - $555,000/yr ($138,750/qtr) •Year 6 - $570,000/yr ($142,500/qtr) •Year 7 - $590,000/yr ($147,500/qtr) •Year 8 - $605,000/yr ($151,250/qtr) •Year 9 - $625,000/yr ($156,250/qtr) •Year 10* - $645,000/yr ($161,250/qtr) * For each year beyond Year 10 after the Effective Date that the Agreement remains in effect, the Annual Oversight Fee shall be the Year 10 Amount increased by the CPI (see Section 4.9.4.2 below for additional detail).

clauses.head: 4.9.4.1 If the Effective Date is other than
clauses.name: 4.9.4.1 Proration
clauses.tail: until the last day of the Term.
clauses.text: 4.9.4.1 If the Effective Date is other than on the first day of a calendar quarter, the rate applicable to Year 1 shall be paid on the Effective Date and calculated ratably for the portion of the calendar quarter from the Effective Date until the end of the calendar quarter containing the Effective Date, and the rate applicable to final year of the Term shall be paid ratably for the portion of the calendar quarter from the beginning of the calendar quarter in which the Term ends until the last day of the Term.

clauses.head: 4.9.4.2 For any year that the Agreement is
clauses.name: 4.9.4.2 CPI Increase
clauses.tail: would be 110% (100 + 10, stated as a percentage).
clauses.text: 4.9.4.2 For any year that the Agreement is in effect after Year 10, the Annual Oversight Fee shall be the per annum amount of (a) Annual Oversight #10069598_v13 46 Fee applicable to Year 10 multiplied by (b) 100 plus the increase in CPI from the beginning of Year 10 to the beginning of the year in question, stated as a percentage. The foregoing may be illustrated by the following example: Assume CPI for the initial measurement date at the beginning of Year 10 is 150; assume also that CPI at the beginning of Year 12 is 165. The Annual Oversight Fee multiplier for Year 12 would be 110% (100 + 10, stated as a percentage).

clauses.head: 4.9.4.3 If CPI is converted to a different
clauses.name: 4.9.4.3 CPI Revision or Replacement
clauses.tail: most recently published prior to the measuring date in question.
clauses.text: 4.9.4.3 If CPI is converted to a different standard reference base or otherwise revised, a determination of CPI Escalation shall be made with the use of such conversion factor, formula or table as may be published by the Bureau or, if the Bureau shall not publish the same, then with the use of such conversion factor, formula or table as may be published by any nationally recognized publisher of statistical information, reasonably selected by MTC. If CPI shall cease to be published, then there shall be substituted for CPI any substitute or successor index published by the Bureau or other governmental agency, or if no such index is published, then such other index published by any nationally recognized publisher of statistical information as MTC shall reasonably select. CPI means the CPI most recently published prior to the measuring date in question.

clauses.head: 4.9.5 Revenue Sharing Payment. Network Operator shall pay
clauses.name: 4.9.5 Revenue Sharing Payment
clauses.tail: million.
clauses.text: 4.9.5 Revenue Sharing Payment. Network Operator shall pay MTC, within 45 days after the end of each fiscal year of the Network Operator, an amount equal to the following percentages of Network Revenue attributable to that fiscal year, and such #10069598_v13 47 payments shall be incremental to the Annual Oversight Fee described in Section 4.9.4 above: 4.9.5.1 Zero Percent (0%) on first $3 million annual Network Revenue; plus 4.9.5.2 Four Percent (4%) on annual Network Revenue greater than $3 million but less than or equal to $6 million; plus 4.9.5.3 Twenty Percent (20%) on annual Network Revenue greater than $6 million.

clauses.head: 4.9.6 CAPEX Upgrade and Update Fund. Starting with
clauses.name: 4.9.6 CAPEX Upgrade and Update Fund
clauses.tail: funding additional extensions to the MTC Network.
clauses.text: 4.9.6 CAPEX Upgrade and Update Fund. Starting with the first day of the first full calendar quarter following the Commencement Date, Network Operator will pay to MTC, within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter, the greater of One Hundred Thousand Dollars ($100,000) or Five Percent (5%) of Network Revenue, for the purpose of funding a CAPEX Upgrade and Update Fund to be held by MTC. To the extent that the amounts in the Fund exceed the amounts reasonably required for the purposes of the Fund, any excess amounts may be used by MTC for any purpose related to the MTC Network that is consistent with MBI's legislatively stated mission, including without limitation funding additional extensions to the MTC Network.

clauses.head: 4.9.7 Potential Decommissioning Fund. Starting on the Effective
clauses.name: 4.9.7 Potential Decommissioning Fund
clauses.tail: under this Section for the entire Term of the Agreement.
clauses.text: 4.9.7 Potential Decommissioning Fund. Starting on the Effective Date, Network Operator will pay to MTC within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar year, an amount equal to Two Percent (2%) of Network Revenue to fund the decommissioning of the MTC Network, in whole or in part, when it reaches the end of its useful life or at such other time as MTC determines decommissioning is appropriate. If MTC determines at any time in its sole discretion that the funds so collected or any portion thereof will not likely be necessary for decommissioning, then MTC may use #10069598_v13 48 such funds or portion thereof for any purpose consistent with MBI's legislatively stated mission. No such determination shall diminish or modify the Network Operator's obligation to make the payments required under this Section for the entire Term of the Agreement.

clauses.head: 4.9.8 Timing of Payments to MTC. Any payments
clauses.name: 4.9.8 Timing of Payments to MTC
clauses.tail: quarterly unless another payment schedule is specified herein.
clauses.text: 4.9.8 Timing of Payments to MTC. Any payments required to be paid by the Network Operator to MTC pursuant to this Agreement shall be paid quarterly unless another payment schedule is specified herein.

clauses.head: 4.9.9 Network Operator Financial Reporting. Network Operator shall
clauses.name: 4.9.9 Network Operator Financial Reporting
clauses.tail: definition of that term in ARTICLE 2.
clauses.text: 4.9.9 Network Operator Financial Reporting. Network Operator shall furnish MTC with the following Financial Statements reflecting all Network Operator's assets, liabilities, income expenses, not limited to those related to the MTC Network: 4.9.9.1 Quarterly, within sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter, an unaudited Financial Statement for the quarter just ended; 4.9.9.2 Annually, within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of the Network Operator's fiscal year, an audited Financial Statement for the fiscal year just ended; and 4.9.9.3 Quarterly, sufficient information and analysis to establish, to MTC's reasonable satisfaction, the accuracy and completeness of payments made or owed to MTC and of any assertions by the Network Operator that the cost of any an extension qualifies it as a Network Operator Network Extension or as any other kind of Network Extension within the meaning of the definition of that term in ARTICLE 2.

clauses.head: 4.9.9.4 Each Financial Statement shall be accompanied by
clauses.name: 4.9.9.4 Officer's Certificate
clauses.tail: record or information from which such statement was derived.
clauses.text: 4.9.9.4 Each Financial Statement shall be accompanied by an Officer's Certificate certifying that (a) the Financial Statement has been #10069598_v13 49 prepared from Network Operator's books and records in accordance with IFRS, is true, correct and complete and fairly presents in all material respects the financial condition of Network Operator as of the dates, and for the periods, indicated thereon and (b) there has been no fraud or intentional or willful misconduct by any Person in connection with the recordation, maintenance or preparation of the Financial Statement, or any other financial documents, record or information from which such statement was derived.

clauses.head: 4.10 Restrictions on Long Term Wholesale Customer Contracts.
clauses.name: 4.10 Restrictions on Long Term Wholesale Customer Contracts
clauses.tail: more than two (2) years after actual receipt thereof.
clauses.text: 4.10 Restrictions on Long Term Wholesale Customer Contracts. The Network Operator shall not enter into a contract with a Wholesale Customer, without the prior written consent of MTC, acting reasonably, having a stated duration of more than two (2) years for which application of IFRS would call for recognition of revenue derived from the contract more than two (2) years after actual receipt thereof.

clauses.head: 4.11 Maintenance Requirements, Procedures and Reporting 4.11.1 Network
clauses.name: 4.11.1 Maintenance Standard
clauses.tail: so as to maintain the standards for carrier class networks.
clauses.text: 4.11 Maintenance Requirements, Procedures and Reporting 4.11.1 Network Operator shall maintain the MTC Network in compliance with the applicable codes and the specifications contained or incorporated, or to be contained or incorporated, in MTC's agreement with its Design-Build Contractor, reasonable wear and tear excepted, in a manner which will permit ready access to it at all times for Wholesale Customers in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement and their respective SLAs and other Wholesale Customer agreements, and so as to maintain the standards for carrier class networks.

clauses.head: 4.11.2 Scheduled Maintenance. Network Operator shall perform appropriate
clauses.name: 4.11.2 Scheduled Maintenance
clauses.tail: meet or exceed standard industry practice.
clauses.text: 4.11.2 Scheduled Maintenance. Network Operator shall perform appropriate Scheduled Maintenance on the physical plant of the MTC Network in accordance with all #10069598_v13 50 applicable laws, codes and regulations, the MassDOT Operating Agreement and with Network Operator’s then current preventative maintenance procedures, which shall meet or exceed standard industry practice.

clauses.head: 4.11.3 Notice of Scheduled Maintenance. Network Operator shall
clauses.name: 4.11.3 Notice of Scheduled Maintenance
clauses.tail: previous sentence to reschedule any delayed activity.
clauses.text: 4.11.3 Notice of Scheduled Maintenance. Network Operator shall notify MTC and any affected Wholesale Customer interconnected to the MTC Network at least ten (10) days prior to any Scheduled Maintenance which will or is reasonably likely to have a material impact on service. Network Operator will normally perform Scheduled Maintenance which is reasonably expected to produce any signal discontinuity during standard maintenance windows to be established by Network Operator. If Scheduled Maintenance must occur outside such standard maintenance windows, Network Operator shall use its best efforts to coordinate between the Parties and any affected Wholesale Customer. MTC may not prevent Network Operator from performing maintenance that Network Operator deems necessary. MTC shall have the right to be present during the performance of any Scheduled Maintenance or Unscheduled Maintenance so long as this requirement does not interfere with Network Operator’s ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement. In the event that Scheduled Maintenance is canceled or delayed for whatever reason as previously notified, Network Operator shall notify MTC and any affected Wholesale Customer at Network Operator’s earliest opportunity, and will comply with the provisions of the previous sentence to reschedule any delayed activity.

clauses.head: 4.11.4 Unscheduled Maintenance. Network Operator shall notify MTC
clauses.name: 4.11.4 Unscheduled Maintenance
clauses.tail: MassDOT Operating Agreement to take corrective action.
clauses.text: 4.11.4 Unscheduled Maintenance. Network Operator shall notify MTC and any affected Wholesale Customer interconnected to the MTC Network as soon as possible after becoming aware of the need for any Unscheduled Maintenance. Network Operator shall perform Unscheduled Maintenance, which shall consist of: #10069598_v13 51 4.11.4.1 Emergency Unscheduled Maintenance in response to an alarm identification originated by either Network Operator or MTC, notification by a Third Party Service Provider, end-user or by any other third party of any verifiable failure, interruption or impairment in the operation of the MTC Network, or upon learning of any event imminently likely to cause the failure, interruption or impairment in the operation of the MTC Network; and 4.11.4.2 Non-Emergency Unscheduled Maintenance in response to any potential service-affecting situation to prevent any failure, interruption or impairment in the operation of the MTC Network not covered by Scheduled Maintenance. Network Operator shall use its best efforts to promptly report the need for Unscheduled Maintenance to MTC in accordance with Network Operator's reasonable procedures, recognizing that in some instances such notification may not be possible until after the Unscheduled Maintenance has occurred, in which case such notification shall be given as soon as possible but no later than the start of the next business day. Network Operator will log the time of any such report, verify the problem and dispatch personnel in accordance with its SLAs and with the MassDOT Operating Agreement to take corrective action.

Network Operator’s maintenance personnel shall be available for dispatch twenty-four #10069598_v13 52 (24) hours a day, seven (7) days a week. Network Operator shall maintain a toll-free telephone number for the contacting of personnel at the NOC. Network Operator’s NOC personnel shall dispatch maintenance and repair personnel along the system to handle and repair problems detected in the MTC Network: (i) through Network Operator’s remote surveillance equipment and/or upon notification by MTC, MassDOT, ITD, EOPSS or a Third Party Service Provider; or (ii) upon credible notification by any third party or verification thereof. Network Operator shall make and maintain arrangements for a back- up location for the NOC or remote management capability in the event its usual location unexpectedly becomes unavailable or unusable, and shall inform MTC of such arrangements.

In the event that any Scheduled or Unscheduled Maintenance hereunder requires a truck roll or reconfiguration involving cable, fiber, electronic equipment, or regeneration or other MTC facilities, then Network Operator shall make such personnel available as may be necessary in order to accomplish such maintenance.

clauses.text: 6.2 Changes to Agreement Resulting from Periodic Service Requirement Reviews. Within thirty (30) days after submission of annual recommendations by the IPT, (i) the Parties shall make a threshold determination as to whether the changes proposed by the IPT may be implemented without an amendment to the Agreement; and, (ii) if the changes are determined to result in a material change in scope, price, terms and conditions of this Agreement, then the Parties may either negotiate to amend the Agreement (including the Schedules thereto) or consider the change during any subsequent renewal. If a mutual determination is made that such changes can be implemented without the requirement of an amendment to this Agreement, their implementation nonetheless shall require the express written approval of both parties.
